why.terrace: Loud home ends at Turf Moor, known in England, not a famous organised end
why.city: Small East Lancashire mill town; among the best-supported clubs per capita
why.voice: No supporter ownership; local businessmen and fans ran it until the 2020 takeover
why.conscience: Fan given three-year ban for racist abuse of a Blackburn player (2025); club reported it; 2019 report had Burnley fans highest for hate-crime reports; EqualGame award to a fan (2019)
why.ground: Turf Moor, home since 1883, ~22,000, compact and usually full
why.contender: Yo-yo club: Championship titles 2016 and 2023, 100 points in 2024-25; relegated from the PL in 2026
why.rituals: No Nay Never; Bene and Hot served since WWI; known in England
why.stewardship: ALK Capital (Alan Pace), 84% leveraged buyout in 2020, loans secured on the club
why.women: Burnley Women in the second tier (estimate)
why.intensity: Parker's sides built on defence; current approach under Nicky Hayen unclear (estimate)
